questions.e: Present Simple: he/she/it bilan fe’lga -s qo‘shiladi: plays.
O‘tgan zamon (Past Simple): go → went. "Yesterday" o‘tgan zamon belgisi.
He/she/it bilan so‘roq "Does" bilan boshlanadi, fe’l -s siz qoladi: Does she speak?
Qisqa sifatlarda qiyoslash -er bilan: tall → taller than.

questions.q: How ___ water do you drink every day?
questions.e: Water — sanalmaydigan ot, shuning uchun "How much".

questions.q: There ___ two books on the table.

questions.e: "At the moment" — hozir davom etayotgan ish: Present Continuous (is watching).

questions.q: There aren't ___ apples in the fridge.

questions.e: "doesn't" dan keyin fe’l -s siz keladi: She doesn't like.
